switchLangDesc: The language of the app's buttons and labels.
switchThemeDesc: System follows your device's light or dark setting.
defaultPaperDesc: Used when photos are converted to PDF. Fit keeps each photo's own shape.
defaultTextDesc: Added to every new palang. You can still edit it per document.
title: Prepare documents for sharing
lede: Palang turns your photos and PDFs into ready-to-share documents: convert, stamp the bank-purpose band, merge. Everything runs on your device, and nothing is uploaded.
featureConvertBody: Photos into one PDF, with a crop and a light enhance for each image, and your choice of page size.
featurePalangBody: The official-use band: the palang that banks, government offices and companies ask for. Drag it, rotate it and scale it like a real stamp. The lines follow your text and stay transparent.
featureMergeBody: Join PDFs in the order you want, straight from your device.
step1B: Photos or PDFs from your device.
step2B: Drag the band where it belongs, rotate it, size it, and watch it change as you go.
step3B: One file ready to share. Nothing was sent anywhere.
private1b: Conversion, stamping and merging all run on your device.
private2a: No accounts, no sign-ins, no tracking.
private4b: The only network request is a small update check.
private5b: Malaysia's PDPA 2010 governs how those who collect personal data must handle it. Palang does not collect it: nothing is stored and nothing is uploaded, so there is nothing to protect, leak or lose.
faq5q: Why does my photo have a white border in the PDF?
faq5a: Palang places each page onto the page size you chose (A4 by default) and fits the image inside it, the same way banks and offices expect copies. The preview shows exactly this. To fill the page instead, crop the photo or pick a smaller page size.
heroTagline: Prepare documents for sharing. Everything runs on your device.
dlNote: Builds are published on GitHub Releases.
featConvertPoint2: Crop and light enhance, per photo.
featConvertPoint3: A4, A5, Letter or the photo's own size.
featPalangPoint1: A transparent band with your purpose text and a line above and below it.
featPalangPoint2: Drag, rotate and scale it like a real stamp.
featPalangPoint3: One marking, placed exactly where you need it.
featMergePoint1: Join files in the order you choose.
featMergePoint2: Page through the whole merged result before saving.
installSub: Both builds are the same app. Neither needs an account or a connection to work.
installWinStep1: Download the installer from GitHub Releases.
installWinStep2: Run the file and follow the prompts.
installWinStep3: Open Palang from the Start menu. It works offline.
installApkStep1: Download the APK from GitHub Releases.
installApkStep2: Open the file, and allow installs from this source when Android asks.
installReqList: Windows 10 or newer. Android 8 or newer.
installUpdatesBody: The app checks the published version when it opens and tells you when a newer build is available. On a phone or Windows app, "Update" opens the download page to install it.
privacyLede: Palang does its work on your device. Your files are not uploaded, and there is no account.
privacySite: This website is static. It has no analytics, no trackers and no cookies, and it never touches your documents.
privacyOpenBody: The app is public under the MIT licence. The code can be read and audited.
privacyContact: Found a problem? Open an issue on GitHub.
helpConvert: Tap a photo to open it, then crop or enhance it. Choose a paper size above — a size that matches the image leaves no white border.
helpPalang: Tap a document to add a palang. Drag to place it, the corner handle stretches it, pinch or the mouse wheel zooms, and double-click the text to edit it.
helpMerge: Add two or more PDFs, reorder them with the arrows, then merge. Tap a file to preview its pages.
cvPageOwn: Each photo becomes a page shaped like the photo, with no white border.
cvPageFit: Each photo becomes one page in this size. The thumbnails show the proportion.
cvRemoveConfirm: Remove this photo from the list? This cannot be undone.
mgPickHint: Pick the files. The result follows the order in the list, which you can rearrange.
mgNoPreview: This page cannot be previewed. It will still be merged as it is.
plStillPreparing: Still preparing your document… large files can take a little longer.
plNoPreview: This page can’t be previewed: the marking is still placed at its true size.
plNoPalangHere: This photo has no palang yet.
pcDblEdit: Double-click to edit the palang text
plUnable: Unable to prepare this document. It may be too large or unsupported.

sessionEmpty: Nothing yet. Convert, stamp or merge a document and it will appear here.

pcReset: Reset marking position to the middle

splitChoose: Choose a PDF to extract from
splitChooseHint: The pages you list are copied out; the original is left untouched.

splitNoPages: Type at least one valid page or range.
resultHintApp: Saved or shared on your device
aboutUpToDate: You are on the latest version
docRepo: the app (Svelte 5), the whole product; its engine (pdf-lib) runs on the device
docDevHost: Run npm run dev:app:host and open the printed Network URL on a phone on the same Wi-Fi; it opens the tools at the #/convert route. Allow Node through the firewall the first time.
docVarFull: the public site: landing, install, privacy and the per-feature pages
docVarApp: the tools only, no site: the bundle the EXE and APK are packaged from
docConfigBody: One dotenv source: .env.production holds the committed defaults, .env.local (gitignored) holds your overrides (e.g. a staging domain).
docLimits: Runtime operator caps live in public/limits.json and can be changed without a rebuild.
docEngineA: Everything runs on the device: the PDF engine (pdf-lib) is bundled into the app. Convert, stamp and merge never leave it.
docEngineB: The same engine powers the Windows and Android builds: one codebase, identical output.
docEngineC: Servers never do the work: a static host only serves the site files; processing is always on the device.
docDockerBody: One image: nginx serving the site build. Only needed when you want to run the site yourself; any static host is a free alternative.
docDockerLimits: Override limits.json without rebuilding: docker run -p 8000:80 -v ./limits.json:/usr/share/nginx/html/limits.json:ro palang-web
docHostingBody: The site is plain static files, so it runs free on Vercel, Cloudflare Pages or any static host. The apps do all the work on the device.
docPackBody: Version and release are one step: npm version bumps package.json and tags, then push the tag. A single workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml) builds the Windows EXE/MSI and the Android APK and attaches both to one draft release. To build test artifacts without publishing, run that workflow manually.
docPackWinBody: Built by Tauri on a Windows runner, then attached to the GitHub release.
docPackApkBody: Built by Capacitor, debug-signed so it can be installed straight away.
docPackSign: Publishing to the Play Store needs your keystore wired into the Android signing config.
docLede: How the site and the two app builds are produced, from one codebase.
docPublishingBody: Push to main and the Pages workflow builds the site and deploys it to GitHub Pages. A custom domain can serve it from the root by setting SITE_BASE=/ in that workflow.
cfDeleteImagesBody: They are removed from your list.
cfRemovePalangBody: The palang is removed from this page.
cfRevertBody: This goes back to the original.
